id: AT-RN-11 (needs a Windows host lacks: skipped cases, steps not run, owner-bit modes)
note: The runner as Git for Windows' Perl sees it, run on any host through --assume-missing: a case that needs unix-pid1 (pid 1 standing in for Claude Code; MSYS has no pid 1) skips, and so does a case that names no need but uses pid 1's start time placeholder, in its own text, in a setups/ file it runs or in a sequence's seed copy (a case-local fixtures folder through --fixtures); a step that needs ps-lstart is not run and named under its case while the next step runs, and with exact-modes an expected mode compares the owner write bit only (noacl mounts read 0644 for a 0600 file), with a count line. Without the flag the same pid-1 cases run and fail, so the probes count as met on macOS and Linux; those two steps need unix-pid1 themselves, so a host that lacks it does not run them. Sitting 4's needs (symlinks, exact-modes, long-paths, unix-os, posix-names) assumed missing leave their steps not run, each named under its case; on a host that has them they count as met; and a symlink setup action where links are missing (Git for Windows' MSYS perl copies the target) ends its case with that reason, never with a copy

steps.name: with unix-pid1, ps-lstart and exact-modes assumed missing

stdout_has: ^ok \d+ - AT-RN-11-inner-lstart1 # SKIP needs unix-pid1 \(the case uses .LSTART1\)$
^ok \d+ - AT-RN-11-inner-lstart1-setup # SKIP needs unix-pid1 \(the case uses .LSTART1\)$
^ok \d+ - AT-RN-11-inner-step\n#   not run here: step 1 \(reads a start time\) \(needs ps-lstart\)$
^# modes compared by the owner write bit only \(chmod does not set modes here\): 1 checks$

steps.name: on this host the needs count as met: the pid-1 case runs and fails
and the case that uses pid 1's start time without naming the need runs and fails
a sequence case whose seed copy uses pid 1's start time skips too

stdout_has: ^ok \d+ - AT-RN-11-inner-seq # SKIP needs unix-pid1 \(the case uses .LSTART1\)$

steps.name: sitting 4's needs assumed missing: their steps are not run, each named, and the next step runs

stdout_has:
^ok 1 - AT-RN-11-inner-tokens
#   not run here: step 1 \(plants a link\) \(needs symlinks\)
#   not run here: step 2 \(reads a mode chmod set\) \(needs exact-modes\)
#   not run here: step 3 \(inits a repository past MAX_PATH\) \(needs long-paths\)
#   not run here: step 4 \(restarts on update\) \(needs unix-os\)
#   not run here: step 5 \(names a file x\*\[y\]\) \(needs posix-names\)$

steps.name: on this host they count as met: the steps run and fail
a symlink setup action where links are missing ends its case with the reason

stdout_has: ^#   plants a link setup: symlink \S+/link\.txt: no real symlinks here \(give the case or step "needs": \["symlinks"\]\)$
